app_fee.value: The Kennedy College of Sciences lists a $50 application fee; the graduate office calls the application fee non-waivable.

fee_waiver.value: The graduate office says the application fee cannot be waived for any applicant.
fee_waiver.quote: A non-waivable and non-refundable application fee must be received before the application is processed.

gre_general.value: GRE rules are set by each college: sciences require it only for Medical Physics and Radiological Sciences, while engineering PhD programs require it; see each program.

toefl_min.value: The graduate office sets a minimum TOEFL score of 79.

ielts_min.value: The graduate office sets a minimum IELTS Academic score of 6.5.

english_waiver.value: The pages name only a two-semester full-time U.S. study waiver; India and English-medium degrees are not addressed.

notes: Application fee: the Kennedy College of Sciences page lists $50; the engineering page names the fee without an amount. Institutionally approved English tests include Duolingo (115+ on the Kennedy page) and PTE (53+), which the university fields do not cover. Thresholds are set by departments; the sciences and international pages both give 79 TOEFL and 6.5 IELTS.
